name: Spirit

story.who_i_am: I'm Spirit, a six-wheeled robot geologist, about the size of a golf cart.
story.why_sent: NASA sent me to find out if water once flowed on Mars. They planned 90 days for me.
story.discoveries: When my front wheel broke, I drove backwards and dragged it. It scraped the ground and uncovered almost pure silica: a sign of ancient hot springs.
story.where_now: In 2009 I got stuck in soft sand. I kept working without moving until I went silent in 2010.
story.legacy: My twin Opportunity, then Curiosity and Perseverance, continued the search for water and life.

human_touch: For months, my team tried everything to free me. They called it the 'Free Spirit' campaign.
voice_text: Hello? … Is someone there? You found me! I'm Spirit, a robot geologist with six wheels. In 2004, NASA sent me to Mars to look for signs of ancient water. The plan was three months. I worked for more than six years. One day, my front wheel stopped turning. So I drove backwards, dragging it behind me. And guess what? The broken wheel scraped the ground and uncovered something bright white: silica. On Earth, it forms near hot springs. So Mars was once warm and wet in this place! In 2009, I got stuck in soft sand. I couldn't turn my solar panels toward the Sun for winter… and I went quiet. But my twin, Opportunity, and later Curiosity and Perseverance, kept exploring. Keep listening. There are more of us out there.

proof_image.caption: Spirit seen from orbit by the HiRISE camera

minigame.intro: My front right wheel is stuck. Drive me to Home Plate and find what is hidden under the dust. Watch the battery!
minigame.hint: Driving forward with a stuck wheel drains the battery and pulls you sideways. What if you turned around and drove backwards, dragging the wheel?
minigame.success: That's what really happened in 2007! I was driving backwards, dragging my stuck wheel. It scraped away the dust and uncovered bright soil that was nearly pure silica. On Earth, silica like this forms in hot springs or steam vents: Mars once had hot water here.
